baseFrontend: validated 7.10.1 UI baseline with restart-safe backend auto-update management and complete npm runtime packaging
label: v7-10-2
notes: Built from the 7.10.1 stable candidate without changing the validated frontend baseline.
Auto-update runtime state is stored in acknowledged adapter states and never in the running instance native configuration.
Startup reconciliation is delayed so the web server can finish serving the initial browser assets.
Backend compilation is mandatory before pack/publish and packaged local runtime imports are verified.
changes: Removed the self-triggered eos-admin restart loop caused by writing eosNexoWattAutoUpdateState to system.adapter.eos-admin.0.native.
Added restart-safe info.nexowattStableUpdatesEnabled and info.nexowattStableUpdatesState objects.
Stopped auto-update timers during web server shutdown and avoided unchanged adapter/system configuration writes.
Added backend dependency closure, syntax and npm artifact completeness tests.
Guaranteed build/lib/eosRequestSecurity.js is compiled and packaged before release.
